profile.name: Mobile Web / AR — strict
profile.source_note: File, triangle, and texture-resolution budgets follow Khronos's web AR audit-profile example. The 64 MiB texture-memory budget is a project heuristic and must be validated on target devices.

findings.message: The GLB exceeds the file-size budget for profile 'Mobile Web / AR — strict'.
findings.rationale: Transfer size affects download time, data usage, and time to first render, especially on constrained networks.
findings.recommendation: Inspect texture size and geometry, then compare an optimized output.
findings.threshold_source: File, triangle, and texture-resolution budgets follow Khronos's web AR audit-profile example. The 64 MiB texture-memory budget is a project heuristic and must be validated on target devices.

findings.message: At least one texture exceeds the resolution budget for profile 'Mobile Web / AR — strict'.
findings.rationale: Large texture dimensions increase decoded GPU memory even when the transferred image is compressed.
findings.recommendation: Resize textures by material role and verify fine details visually.
findings.threshold_source: File, triangle, and texture-resolution budgets follow Khronos's web AR audit-profile example. The 64 MiB texture-memory budget is a project heuristic and must be validated on target devices.

findings.message: Estimated texture GPU memory exceeds the heuristic budget for profile 'Mobile Web / AR — strict'.
findings.rationale: High decoded texture memory can cause memory pressure, stuttering, or eviction on target devices.
findings.recommendation: Consider KTX2 GPU compression or lower resolutions, then test on representative hardware.
